content.title: Chapter 22 - BUSINESSES — Sec. 22-166. - Application fee.
content.summary:
Each applicant shall pay an application fee of $500.00 at the time of filing an application.
               Such application fee shall be nonrefundable, except as otherwise provided in
section 22-167
(b).
(Code 1981, § 16-6; Ord. No. 3292, § 1, 10-21-1996)
